name: St. Joseph
title: Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary
summary: The quiet guardian of the Holy Family and model of just manhood.
story: Chosen by God to protect and raise Jesus alongside Mary. Scripture records zero words spoken by him—only immediate obedience to God's will.

name: St. Benedict of Nursia
title: Father of Western Monasticism
summary: Founded the Benedictine order and established the rule of 'Ora et Labora' (Pray and Work).
story: Fleeing the corruption of Rome, Benedict lived in a cave as a hermit before gathering disciples to establish monasteries centered on community prayer and work.

name: St. Augustine of Hippo
title: Doctor of Grace
summary: One of the greatest theologians of the Church whose conversion inspired millions.
story: After years of living a sinful life and seeking truth in philosophy, Augustine converted through the prayers of his mother St. Monica and became Bishop of Hippo.
quote: Our heart is restless until it rests in You.

name: St. Catherine of Siena
title: Doctor of the Church
summary: Dominican tertiary who persuaded the Pope to return to Rome from Avignon.
story: A mystic and counselor to popes and princes, Catherine worked tirelessly for Church unity and the care of the sick during the plague.
quote: Be who God meant you to be and you will set the world on fire.

name: St. Thomas Aquinas
title: The Angelic Doctor
summary: Dominican friar and master theologian who wrote the Summa Theologiae.
story: Synthesized Aristotelian philosophy with Christian theology, creating one of the intellectual foundations of the Western Church.
quote: To one who has faith, no explanation is necessary.

name: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
title: The Little Flower
summary: Taught 'The Little Way' of holiness through small daily acts done with great love.
story: Entered the Carmelite convent at 15 and lived a quiet life of interior trust in God, recorded in her autobiography 'Story of a Soul'.
quote: Miss no single opportunity of making some small sacrifice.

name: St. Teresa of Ávila
title: Doctor of Prayer
summary: Carmelite reformer and mystic who wrote masterworks on mental prayer.
story: Reformed the Carmelite Order alongside St. John of the Cross and wrote 'The Interior Castle', detailing the soul's journey to God.
quote: Let nothing disturb you, let nothing frighten you.

name: St. Francis de Sales
title: Doctor of Charity
summary: Gentle bishop who taught that devotion and holiness are meant for everyone in daily life.
story: Used written pamphlets and gentle dialogue to win back thousands during the Reformation, authoring 'Introduction to the Devout Life'.
quote: A spoonful of honey attracts more flies than a barrel of vinegar.

name: St. Dominic Savio
title: Patron of Choirboys & Youth
summary: Student of St. John Bosco who achieved sanctity at a very young age.
story: Died at just 14 years old, leaving behind a profound witness of joy, purity, and dedication to God in everyday student life.

name: Bl. Carlo Acutis
title: Patron of the Internet
summary: Modern teenager who cataloged Eucharistic miracles online.
story: Used his passion for technology to build websites documenting Eucharistic miracles before dying of leukemia in 2006 at age 15.
quote: All people are born as originals, but many die as photocopies.
